value.signature: fn encode_proof (proof : & DependencyProof) -> Result < Vec < u8 > , ProofError >

review.body: { let encoded = proof_value (proof) . to_canonical_bytes () ; decode_proof (& encoded) ? ; Ok (encoded) }
review.item_premise: The selected proof writer constructs an ordinary canonical Value containing S_D and the complete D, and the public encoder records receiver and result in full. Its decoder self-check records the same public supplied values; neither route authenticates the retained act.
